definitions.explanation: Completely white without any other color mixed in.
Having nothing written or recorded; empty of content.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}で{辺|あた}り{一面|いちめん}{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}だ。
examples.english: The whole area is pure white with snow.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っ{白|しろ}なドレスを{着|き}た{花嫁|はなよめ}が{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: The bride in the pure white dress was beautiful.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}が{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}になった。
{緊張|きんちょう}で{頭|あたま}が{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}になって、{何|なに}も{言|い}えなかった。
examples.english: My mind went blank from nervousness, and I couldn't say anything.

examples.japanese: {答案|とうあん}{用紙|ようし}が{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}のまま{時間|じかん}が{過|す}ぎてしまった。
examples.english: Time passed with the answer sheet still completely blank.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{真|ま}っ (emphatic prefix) + {白|しろ} (white)
The っ intensifies the meaning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{頭|あたま}が{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}になる - mind goes blank
・{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}な{嘘|うそ} - complete lie, blatant lie
・{真|ま}っ{白|しろ}に{燃|も}え{尽|つ}きる - to burn out completely

RELATED COLOR INTENSIFIERS:
・{真|ま}っ{黒|くろ} - pitch black
・{真|ま}っ{赤|か} - bright red, blatant
・{真|ま}っ{青|さお} - deep blue, pale
・{真|ま}っ{暗|くら} - pitch dark
